info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Relationship Management API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Relationship Management API facilitates the establishment and management of relationships with correspondent banks. It enables financial institutions to create and maintain vital banking partnerships, streamline transaction processes, and enhance operational efficiency. This API is essential for banks looking to collaborate with external agencies to support international transactions and services. Typical consumers include banks, financial institutions, and third-party service providers involved in global banking operations.

post.summary: Create a new correspondent bank relationship.
post.description: This operation allows you to establish a new relationship with a correspondent bank. It involves specifying the necessary details and parameters required for the relationship setup.

requestBody.description: Request body for managing the relationship with a correspondent bank in the external agency context. This includes necessary information such as bank details, relationship terms, and operational guidelines.
